scientific_limitations: Exact ternary capacities only for n=2,...,7.
The general upper bound is not asserted to be tight for n>=6 and arbitrary alphabet.
The channel permits arbitrary substitution of up to two consecutive positions but no insertion or deletion, no cyclic wrap, and no successive bursts.

title: Exact ternary nonrepeating two-symbol-burst correction through length seven
